note: COBOL Procedure-Division verbs that the ADMITTED GnuCOBOL 3.2 oracle itself cannot compile/run. gnucobol-rs is oracle-first (correctness = byte-identical to the built cobc 3.2), so it marks these BOUNDARY and does NOT implement them -- there is no cobc output to be byte-identical to. They are recorded here as a build plan for a SEPARATE kobold-side layer that may implement their semantics independently of the GnuCOBOL 3.2 oracle. DATA ONLY: no gnucobol/libcob GPL source is included.
source: gnucobol-rs COBOL-PARITY.md front-end statement census -- 58/66 verbs wired + proven byte-identical, 8 BOUNDARY (these).
boundary: gnucobol-rs's bar is byte-identity with GnuCOBOL 3.2 cobc. These 8 have no cobc 3.2 behavior to match, so implementing them is a non-oracle effort that belongs OUTSIDE the faithful port -- built in a separate kobold-* crate/layer that may depend on gnucobol-rs (LGPL) but never includes it.

verbs.why_boundary_in_gnucobol_rs: GnuCOBOL 3.2 does not implement the COMMUNICATION SECTION (compiles -Wpending "not implemented" + errors "CD record missing")
verbs.build_intent: implement independently in a kobold-side layer with its own conformance oracle (not the GnuCOBOL 3.2 oracle); communication = a message-control runtime, screen = an ACUCOBOL-style GUI surface, ENTRY = separate-compilation-unit entry points
